heroTagline: I design and ship Flutter apps that feel fast, stay maintainable, and scale with real product needs — from Clean Architecture and Bloc to Firebase, REST, OCR, and AI-assisted features.
aboutParagraph1: I build Flutter apps end to end — from product flow and UI to architecture, local storage, and shipping. Across my recent work I’ve delivered a patient care app with NFC check-in and offline clinical records, a QR/barcode scanner with Excel export, a multi-template CV builder with real PDF generation, an OCR study toolkit with AI homework help, and a property expense tracker with budgets, biometric unlock, and cloud sync. I work with Bloc, REST and Firebase where they fit, keep data reliable offline-first, and care about the details users actually feel.
aboutParagraph2: Based in Pakistan and open to remote collaboration worldwide. I communicate clearly with product and engineering teams, debug with discipline, and care about the details users actually feel.

projects.title: Patient Management App
projects.tagline: A Flutter patient app for a physiotherapy clinic that keeps care records, sessions, and billing in one place. Patients can view visits and clinical assessments, track session progress and invoices, submit visit feedback, and use an NFC digital card for clinic check-in — with SQLite caching so key data stays available offline.

projects.title: Expenseo App
projects.tagline: A Flutter expense tracker built around properties — homes, shops, and apartments — with monthly budgets in PKR, categorized spending, and optional receipt photos. Users review monthly breakdowns and export PDF reports, with offline SQLite storage and Firestore sync so data stays available and up to date.

projects.title: CareerBoost CV Builder
projects.tagline: A Flutter resume builder where users pick from ten templates, fill a multi-step form, preview layouts, and save drafts locally. It generates real PDFs with share/export (plus DOCX), and unlocks extra templates with rewarded ads.

projects.title: Scanix
projects.tagline: A Flutter QR and barcode scanner that works from the live camera or gallery photos, then saves results locally with names and categories. History stays available offline in SQLite, and saved scans can be exported to Excel for day-to-day data management.

projects.title: Neon Toolkit
projects.tagline: A Flutter study companion with Screenshot Brain that extracts text via OCR, sorts captures into smart folders, and exports polished PDFs — plus a Homework Solver that turns camera or typed questions into AI answers. Built with Bloc, SQLite, and Google ML Kit for an on-device first workflow with local history.

experience.title: Flutter Developer

Collaborated through Git/GitHub and validated integrations with Postman, with a focus on performance, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
